sections.description: Version 6.1.0 adds standards-based illustrated reflowable EPUB presentation while preserving existing reader security, navigation, progress, and entitlement boundaries.
sections.changelog: Illustrated EPUB MVP: responsive embedded JPEG, PNG, GIF, and safely supported SVG presentation; contained cover-first reading view; preserved image order, aspect ratio, alt text, captions, and mobile overflow safeguards. Fixed-layout and pre-paginated EPUB rendering are not included.
